facts.fact: MFWA cites Article 31 of Niger's cybercrime law, Law 2019-33 of 3 July 2019, as amended by Ordinance 2024-28 of 7 June 2024.

MFWA says three journalists were charged from 30 October 2025 under Article 31 of the cybercrime law with complicity in disseminating a document likely to disturb public order, the last freed on 28 August 2026.
